machines.title: Booster catch
machines.blurb: The arms have to be ready. Otherwise the booster misses.

invariants.name: CatchNeedsArms
invariants.text: A catch happens only with the arms ready.

invariants.name: MissIsBare
invariants.text: A miss happens with the arms not ready.

story.label: The booster is on the pad.
Caught, because the arms were ready.

machines.title: Bus morning
machines.blurb: Home, the stop, the seat, the ride, then school. Arrival requires boarding.

invariants.name: NoRideBeforeBoard
invariants.text: The ride does not start before boarding.

machines.title: Play clock
machines.blurb: The clock runs on a live play. A timeout freezes it. The snap needs time left.

invariants.name: NoSnapAtZero
invariants.text: The ball is not snapped at zero.

invariants.name: TimeoutFreezes
invariants.text: A timeout holds the clock where it stopped.

story.label: The ball is snapped with time left.
